title: Testing v2 export round-trips: export, JSON reload, then resolve via layout serializer utils
answers: How do I test that a v2 dashboard export reimports correctly?
How to assert the datasource a panel resolves to after makeExportableV2
body:
Pattern used in public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.test.ts ('dashboard exporter v2'):
1. Deep-copy the fixture with `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(handyTestingSchema))` (from @grafana/schema/apis/dashboard.grafana.app/v2/examples), because makeExportableV2 mutates its input.
2. Overwrite `elements['panel-1'].spec.data.spec.queries` with the PanelQuery/DataQuery kinds you need, then call `await makeExportableV2(schema, true)` (true = share externally).
3. Reload with a JSON round-trip, then check what import would resolve. Use getPanelDataSource(panel) and panelQueryKindToSceneQuery(query), both from serialization/layoutSerializers/utils. Don't just check the raw spec.
4. For library panels, use `jest.mocked(getLibraryPanel).mockResolvedValueOnce(...)` with an edited model. The exporter inlines it as a Panel that keeps the same id.
applies: Unit tests for dashboard-scene v2 exporters
